s: noun
a blood group antigen possessed by Rh-positive people; if an Rh-negative person receives a blood transfusion from an Rh-positive person it can result in hemolysis and anemia
آنتی‌ژن گروه خونی Rh
The patient's Rh status was checked before the blood transfusion procedure.
noun
a white hard metallic element that is one of the platinum group and is found in platinum ores; used in alloys with platinum
روتنیوم، فلز سفید و سخت
noun
a city in northeastern France to the east of Paris; scene of the coronation of most French kings; site of the unconditional German surrender in 1945 at the end of World War II
شهری در شمال‌شرق فرانسه، شرق پاریس
Many French kings were crowned in the cathedral at Rheims throughout history.
adjective
of or relating to the Rhine River and the lands adjacent to it
مربوط به رودخانه راین و سرزمین‌های مجاور آن
Rhenish wines tend to be sweet
noun
a rare heavy polyvalent metallic element that resembles manganese chemically and is used in some alloys; is obtained as a by-product in refining molybdenum
رنیوم (فلز نادر سنگین)
Rhenium is a rare metal used in high-temperature alloys for jet engines.
noun
using language effectively to please or persuade
هنر سخن‌گویی و تأثیرگذاری در سخنرانی یا نوشتار
The politician's rhetoric about change won over many undecided voters.
noun
high-flown style; excessive use of verbal ornamentation
سبک پرزرق‌وبرق و غلو در زبان
adjective
of or relating to rhetoric; - W.A.White; - Lewis Mumford
مربوط به سخنوری یا بلاغت
accepted two or three verbal and rhetorical changes I suggested
adjective
given to rhetoric, emphasizing style at the expense of thought
تاکید بر شکل و سبک به جای محتوا
noun
a watery discharge from the mucous membranes (especially from the eyes or nose)
ترشح آبکی از غشاهای مخاطی (به‌خصوص از چشم یا بینی)
The cold gave me a bad case of rheum in my eyes.
noun
rhubarb
راوند
adjective
of or pertaining to arthritis
مرتبط با آرتریت یا بیماری مفاصل
my creaky old joints
noun
any painful disorder of the joints or muscles or connective tissues
بیماری درد‌ناک مفاصل یا عضلات یا بافت‌های پیوندی
My grandmother's rheumatism makes her knees hurt whenever it rains.
noun

a chronic autoimmune disease with inflammation of the joints and marked deformities; something (possibly a virus) triggers an attack on the synovium by the immune system, which releases cytokines that stimulate an inflammatory reaction that can lead to the destruction of all components of the joint
بیماری خودایمنی مزمن با التهاب مفاصل و تغییرشکل‌های واضح
noun
United States parapsychologist (1895-1980)
جوزف بنکس راین (پاراسایکولوژیست آمریکایی)
J.B. Rhine's groundbreaking experiments on ESP changed parapsychology forever.
noun
a major European river carrying more traffic than any other river in the world; flows into the North Sea
رود راین (رودخانه اروپایی اصلی)
noun
massive powerful herbivorous odd-toed ungulate of southeast Asia and Africa having very thick skin and one or two horns on the snout
کرگدن
A rhinoceros can weigh over two tons and run at surprising speeds.
noun

British colonial financier and statesman in South Africa; made a fortune in gold and diamond mining; helped colonize the territory now known as Zimbabwe; he endowed annual fellowships for British Commonwealth and United States students to study at Oxford University (1853-1902)
سسیل رودز، مالیات‌دان و بزرگسال بریتانیایی در آفریقای جنوبی
Cecil Rhodes was a controversial figure who shaped colonial Africa in the late 1800s.
noun
a Greek island in the southeast Aegean Sea 10 miles off the Turkish coast; the largest of the Dodecanese; it was colonized before 1000 BC by Dorians from Argos; site of the Colossus of Rhodes
جزیره رودز، جزیره‌ای یونانی در دریای اژه
noun
a landlocked republic in south central Africa formerly called Rhodesia; achieved independence from the United Kingdom in 1980
زیمبابوه (کشور سابق روديسيا)
Rhodesia gained independence and became Zimbabwe in nineteen eighty.
noun
any shrub of the genus Rhododendron: evergreen shrubs or small shrubby trees having leathery leaves and showy clusters of campanulate (bell-shaped) flowers
رزودندرون (گیاهی با گلهای زیبا و برگهای چرمی)
The rhododendron's pink flowers bloomed beautifully throughout our garden this spring.
noun
correspondence in the sounds of two or more lines (especially final sounds)
هم‌آهنگی در آواهای انتهایی دو یا چند بیت
The rhyme between cat and hat makes this poem fun to read aloud.
verb
compose rhymes
ساختن رایم، شعر سروده
noun
a piece of poetry
شعر، قطعه‌ای از شاعری
verb
be similar in sound, especially with respect to the last syllable
مشابه بودن در آواها، به‌خصوص در سیلاب انتهایی
noun
the basic rhythmic unit in a piece of music
ریتم، تال
the piece has a fast rhythm
noun
recurring at regular intervals
تناوب منظم، تکرار با فواصل برابر
adjective
recurring with measured regularity; - John Galsworthy
با نظم و ترتیب تکرار شونده
the rhythmic chiming of church bells
adjective
recurring with measured regularity; - John Galsworthy
با نظم و ترتیب منظمی تکرار شونده
the rhythmic chiming of church bells
adverb
in a rhythmic manner
به طور آهنگین، با ریتم
the chair rocked rhythmically back and forth
